changes: serious organization of the flare debug - it was getting unwieldy and this tidies things up nicely
new modifications for scaling the final results of inner / outer / other (spoke+orbs) default changes or new scalars:
mostly nuked outer glow - new scalar
increased inner glow - new scalar

moved inner glow radius to be a higher multiplier. It means the sun is always bigger than it's actual physical appearance, but it also means you can see something when you're at pluto - so that's nice.
overall lovely improvements in sun quality here
Fixes to input and resizing of secondary viewports
Dynamic Shadow System
Improvements to tight shadow bounds.
New bias calculations.
Changed to manual shadow sampling.
Updated vessel shadows to use new tight bounds.
Improvements to planet shadow res, scaling based on distance to horizon.
Godrays now interact with the new dynamic planet shadows.
Clouds now interact with the new dynamic planet shadows.
Removed CompareOp from samplers. (Some devices don't seem to like compare op)
Removed polygon offsets from rasterizer pipeline. (Causing more problems than it was solving)
Added ShadowMap class for reuse between systems and utilizing the new brutal partitioning system.
Fixed altitude gauge was not aspect ratio locked when user scaled.
Minor fixes to texture handling for compressed heighmaps.
Fixed when UI is hidden alerts would be created but sit there until the UI is back. Now new alerts will not be created if UI is hidden.
Fixed reseting a gauge UI will also reset the detach state.
Added IPatchedConics interface that should be added to all objects that have patched conics. It requires the implementation of the FlightPlan and ManeuverPlan instances among other things.
Added IParent interface and added to Astronomical class.

Amended IOrbit and IOrbiting classes to clearly delineate data related to an Orbit vs the data related to an Orbiting object. IOrbiting is now used to reference an orbiting object rather than Celestial class instance.

Changed Vehicle class to no longer inherit from Celestial class. It now only inherits from Astronomical class and implements IPatchedConics which ion turn implements IOrbiting and IOrbit interfaces onto the vehicle class.
Changed all references to Vehicle and Celestial Instances to now use IOrbiting, IOrbit or IPatchedConics as appropriate.
Started work on genericizing some common gizmo functionality
Fixed the new maneuver node gizmos being eaten by aberrant weather. The gizmo pass now resides after the atmospherics rendering.
Fixed gauge digit rollers weren't animation based on simulation time.
Added new class for digit rollers so that the digit structs are powered centrally without boxing/unboxing but additionally does not duplicate code - to help debug and solve the 9 to 0 roller issue.
Use PCF on the single-sample averaged cloud shadow
Don't use shadow bias on godrays
Minor refactors in cloud atmosphere code

Bloom wars. Increased the blur size and scalar, but also the threshold. At this very high level, it mostly only catches the sun or anything it has hit very significantly. Additionally significantly reduced the adaptive inner glow, as this was causing extreme sizes as it passed through the atmosphere during orbital sunsets. The distance falloff has been increased to reduce the effect significantly at the outer solar system.
Write cloud transmittance to the alpha channel which sunflare will read directly from the screen buffer
Better apply shadow bias to godrays to hide occasional artifacts
Fix wrong target binding in main atmosphere shader
Adjust godray disocclusion threshold for less artifacts
Revert compression on main cloud detail map as it causes clouds to look weird
Add setting to change cloud color
Tweak earth cloud settings to reduce noise near camera
Fix cloud maxStepSize not deserializing correctly
Updated the planet height sampling on the CPU to match the detail height textures on the GPU.
Updated Luna and Mars tiling detail height textures.
Added BiplanarInfo struct to CelestialRenderData for CPU biplanar texture sampling.
Renamed BiomeMaterials list to Materials inside the BiomeMaterialsReference class as the class name already states usage.

Added UpdateReferences function to TerrainReference for setting the real texture references to avoid constantly generating a hash from a string (garbage!) when getting the references in the CPU height sampling code.
Fixed null reference exception when switching to a planet that has no detail heightmaps.
Added a threshold check to SafeAcos and SafeAsin that will throw an exception on debug builds when large-magnitude out-of-domain inputs are passed.
Fixed collapsing headers got broken in FlightPlan from my Vehicle class changes.
Update KSA to Brutal version 25.6.3.0
This update primarily implements a refactor of the GLFW plugin, and adds the FMOD plugin to the project
Added fist pass implementation of Fmod Core.
Added support to play 2d sounds.
Added button down sounds to gauge buttons.
Fixed creating a maneuver node causing the camera rotation to get stuck while it is in orbit mode
Added ability to calculate current patch and next patch from an given orbit at current game time up to a fixed time in the future.
